valor: In a room isolated from the real world, 10-year-old Juan lives with his grandparents. A strange disease makes his grandfather expel large amounts of matter, and every night they are visited by apparitions that feed on his rotten flesh. The grandmother tries to hide it from him, but one night Juan sneaks out to approach them.
